key_insight: MyTm automates melting-temperature prediction in molecular dynamics by modularizing multiple established melting-point methods and adding ML-based atom classification for robust high-throughput use.
engineering_relevance: It lowers the manual burden and error-prone steps in materials screening workflows, enabling faster autonomous assessment of candidate materials’ thermal stability.
method: Integrates direct-heating, void, modified-void, solid-liquid coexistence, and Z-method workflows.
Uses machine learning to classify solid-like vs liquid-like atoms more accurately than conventional rules.
Provides a fully automated, modular pipeline for high-throughput melting-point calculations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that robustness and efficacy were demonstrated on several well-studied systems, supporting the toolkit’s practicality.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality and generalization of the ML atom-classification model and the chosen MD protocol for each material system.
paper_title: MyTm: An Automated Melting Temperature Calculation Toolkit
